card.name: Cytokine and lab-marker lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation, hyphens or word parts inside lists of lab markers and cytokines, such as interleukin-6, ferritin, or iPTH, serum calcium. It fires just before the next marker or term in the list.

modes.label: Interleukin names
modes.description: The hyphen or partway through interleukin or IL before a number.

modes.label: Commas in lab lists
modes.description: Comma or 'and' after a lab marker in a list of tests or findings.

modes.label: Inside antibody drug names
modes.description: Partway through a monoclonal antibody name.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing with another lab or cytokine term, though the listed tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a list of inflammation or bone lab markers where another marker is about to follow.
